infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pulse Field uses the camera to scan business cards and capture ROSE audit evidence.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pulse Field uses selected photos for business-card OCR and ROSE audit evidence previews.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pulse Field uses your location only when you check in to a route visit.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pulse Field uses the microphone when you record voice notes for CRM follow-up.
